name: instagram-local
description: Instagram channel for Claude Code that runs on your machine with your own Meta app — read and reply to comments and direct messages via the official Instagram API, with comment-to-DM, audio transcription and access control via /instagram-local:access.

access_token.title: Instagram access token
access_token.description: Long-lived token that can read and reply to comments and messages (permissions listed in the README)

business_account_id.title: Instagram account ID
business_account_id.description: ID of the Instagram professional account the token belongs to

verify_token.title: Webhook verify token
verify_token.description: Random string you choose; paste the same value into the webhook settings of your Meta app

app_secret.title: Meta app secret
app_secret.description: Used to check the HMAC-SHA256 signature of each webhook

public_base.title: Public tunnel URL (optional)
public_base.description: HTTPS URL of the tunnel that reaches this machine, needed to send images and audio in DMs

groq_api_key.title: Groq API key (optional)
groq_api_key.description: Transcribes inbound audio with Groq Whisper; leave empty to skip transcription
